experimental_procedure: SI-2-4: A Schlenk tube equipped with a dry ice condenser was charged with liquid NH3 (ca. 6 mL), and then Li metal (34 mg, 4.9 mmol, 187.0 equiv) was added under Ar atmosphere. The blue solution was stirred at -78°C for 30 min, and then a solution of SI-2-3b (14 mg, 26.2 μmol, 1.0 equiv) in THF (0.5 mL) was added. The reaction mixture was stirred at -78°C for 1 h, and then quenched with solid NH4Cl (50 mg). The resulting mixture was allowed to warm to room temperature for the evaporation of liquid NH3.
